text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking "Someone like me could never..."
The fledgling who had curled up small to avoid standing out was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Over the span of three years, she grew large and powerful wings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She who once went unnoticed by all is no longer here.
Now, so many look up with adoration
at the heights to which she soars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And once again, spring arrived—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A certain request came in
for Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A joint training event... with new students?
You want me... to participate in that...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand had been asked to participate
as one of the instructors.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... but if I remember correctly,
the freshmen are supposed to submit requests
for which senior they want to mentor them—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Did someone on the senpais' side
end up unable to participate?
So I'm filling in as a substitute—?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smiling wryly at her perpetually low self-esteem,
I decide it would be quicker to just show her
the text of the request email.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand's name was indeed clearly listed there
as having requested a trainer—
choice_data_list: There's a girl who wants to learn from you
There's a girl who wants to learn from you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Cheval Grand looking completely dazed, I asked her once more... though I could somehow already guess what her answer would be.
choice_data_list: So, what do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uh, well—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I will... participate.
Um—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-If... If you really think...
I'm good enough, that is."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um, well—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'll go... do my best!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Well, I said it, but still...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(N-No way... the others who got called here...
were Kita-san and the rest...?!)

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, it's Kitasan-senpai...!
She's just got that star presence, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text:
Crown-senpai's aura is incredible too!
She's one of the faces of the Satono Group and active on the world stage, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~... S-So that's Duramente-senpai...!
Ugh, the aura is insane...
L-Look, my hands are shaking...!

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, Cheval-senpai next to us too!
You saw the Japan Cup, right?
That running was incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...A-Alright.
Don't be scared, don't be scared...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—It's time.
Let's commence training, then.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um! N-New students, please...
Go receive guidance from the senior Umamusume you chose...!

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...All right.
Looking forward to working with you, Duramente-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red and Yellow Hair Ornament
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready too, please!!
I've been looking forward to today so much!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You both have eyes burning with ideals.

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ever since I first watched your race, Senpai,
I've been chasing after your back!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's why someday I'll catch up and pass you...
Even in the Kikuka Sho that you couldn't run in,
I'll run, and I'll win—

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove I'm 'the strongest'
by capturing the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red and Yellow Hair Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey! Don't you go hogging
all the spotlight!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red and Yellow Hair Ornament
text_block_list.text: Duramente-senpai! My goal is the Tiara route, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red and Yellow Hair Ornament
text_block_list.text:
“So right there, I'm gonna put on an incredible run
that'll make you proud, Senpai!!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red and Yellow Hair Ornament
text_block_list.text:
The glory of achieving the Triple Tiara!!
I'll be sure to prove it right before my senior's eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...I understand your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us begin.
I won't hold back."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The running of the 'strongest' that dwells within this blood...
I shall pass it on to all of you."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!!
Um, something like this—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black and White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
That was extremely informative and helpful.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-You really think so?!
I'm glad to hear that, but...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Still, uhm... you really have an incredible sharpness to your stride, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So rather than copying my running style directly,
it might be better to learn how to race from behind.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black and White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
However—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black and White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
To me, the one I look up to...
...has always, always been you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black and White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
I...
...want to aim for a brilliance like yours.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yup, thanks!!
Then I'll teach you everything I possibly can!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black and White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I would love that, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black and White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Holding what I learned close to my heart.
...Forever and ever, climbing higher.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black and White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Even the throne of the world's strongest.
...I will climb all the way up to it—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the "Japan Derby"!
Heh, not a bad dream at all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Musical Note Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much!
...Honestly, given how my abilities are rated right now, it might be dreaming a bit too big, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Musical Note Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
I know it might sound like I'm talking big
even though I haven't even debuted yet, but...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you think so?
When it comes to setting up the finish line,
the sooner the better, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because that just gives me
more time to use my head.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You have to think, prepare, and build yourself up.
With tireless effort and thorough preparation—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No matter what illusion it is!
There's no doubt that I can make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Musical Note Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Yes... yes, Crown-san!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Musical Note Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
I swear... I will claim it.
Everyone's dream, the Japanese Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...Such incredible heat. They're all so driven, and brimming with talent—)

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, s-sorry!
I was spacing out...!!

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it... I-It's my fault.
My body is small... my voice is quiet... and I barely stand out at all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...Huh. I kind of... sympathize with that...)

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
B-Because of that, I don't even know
how I managed to get enrolled...
I'm being left behind by everyone...

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry.
For someone as talentless as me to ask for coaching...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...No. Not at all.
You have nothing to apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Everyone around seems amazing.
Like they're sparkling, or something..."

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Y-Yes, that's right.
That's why I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Are you comparing yourself and feeling down?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Everyone else is so amazing, while I'm just so hopeless... that's what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I understand. It's easy to worry about what others think.
However, that's...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I think... it's also a chance
to become stronger."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because I lack self-confidence...
I can see so many good things in others.
As well as everything I'm lacking.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Others' good qualities. Areas where you can grow.
If you can embrace and utilize both...
I'm sure you'll become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Strong... I-I...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. So, all that's left now is...
to acknowledge and give yourself credit,
even just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Let's do our best so we can become like that.
Shall we start our training?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, the new students each received guidance from the upperclassmen they looked up to—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the end of that day, during the mock race she challenged...

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaargh—!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!!
Alright, alright! She's winning!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, not bad♪
That's the first step toward your dream!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...That was a good run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The freshmen guided by Kitasan Black and the others each seemed to have achieved remarkable results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah...
*sniff*—

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, I...!
Getting a late start, of all things...!
E-Even after everything Senpai taught me—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, don't worry about that...!
You... did your absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
B-But...!
With a result like this... I-I...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if she thinks, 'Someone like me'...
Even though that's not true at all.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Because—)

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I know... I'm really
nothing special... b-but still!

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do my best not to give up.

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Your Japan Cup, Senpai.
...I was watching it.
I watched it... and that roar gave me chills."

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I felt like... they were telling me,
‘It's all right, you'll be fine.’
‘So march forward toward what you want to become!’"

text_block_list.name: Petite, Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"That run... I'll never, ever forget it.
I'll... muster my courage and forge ahead, too!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngggh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Yeah, I'm... cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after finishing her session and returning to the trainer's office, Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that same timid smile as always,
she still beamed bashfully, as if to say,
"Something wonderful happened."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I was truly... so happy.
Far more than someone like me deserves."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, seeing her march forward as her true self,
unchanging through it all—
someone out there will find the courage to keep going.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why she is nobody else,
and resembles no one—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A "truly great Umamusume," more so than anyone else.
